Tamai wore #19 on that page, but #19 there is listed as Uehara, which shows the roster does not match 2023. The page also lacked the 2023 number assignments. The correct answer, Yoshida (#18) and Uehara (#20), required the 2023 roster. The Orchestrator then compounded this at step 16 by accepting the wrong-year data. But the original source of the failure was WebSurfer supplying a roster for the wrong year, and the number 19 from a 2024 page was not verified for 2023.
